title: Habakkuk
author: Habakkuk the prophet.
audience: Judah, wrestling with evil, judgment, and faith.
historicalSetting: Habakkuk brings honest questions before God and learns to live by faith in God's righteous purposes.
themes: The righteous shall live by faith
keyVerse: Habakkuk 2:4 — "The righteous will live by his faith."
christFocus: Habakkuk points to Christ by grounding life in faith and preparing the way for the New Testament proclamation of justification by faith.
